additions.reason: The Torah's inner chambers are the domain of the true Torah — they are the inner reality of Torah itself. 'חַדְרֵי תּוֹרָה' are what one enters when one has truly attained Torah, making them a bechina of the true Torah and thus of true Adam. The teaching opens with the statement that one who merits them 'enters from chamber to chamber,' gathering precious treasures — these chambers ARE the true Torah experience.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ חַדְרֵי תּוֹרָה... כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִין אֶל הַתּוֹרָה בְּעַצְמוֹ זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת אָדָם בֶּאֱמֶת

additions.reason: The palaces of substitutions/inversions are the direct evil mirror of the chambers of Torah. They are described as producing Torah innovations that merely RESEMBLE true attainments — they are the counterfeit version of חַדְרֵי תּוֹרָה. The phrase 'כִּי אֶת זֶה לְעֻמַּת זֶה עָשָׂה אֱלֹקִים' (God made one opposite the other) establishes the structural opposition. The בְּחִינוֹת (levels) described for the human representation metaphor apply here too: the lower levels of representation correspond to these counterfeit chambers.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה חִדּוּשִׁין שֶׁאֵינָם בָּאִים מִשָּׁם, רַק מֵהֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, כִּי אֶת זֶה לְעֻמַּת זֶה עָשָׂה אֱלֹקִים

additions.reason: True Torah innovations/novelties are explicitly described as having multiple levels, with the deepest being a bechina of the true human form ('בְּחִינַת אָדָם בֶּאֱמֶת'). The metaphor of four levels of representing a human — written word, drawing, carved sculpture, actual person — maps directly onto four levels of Torah insight. The highest level of chiddush is identified as bechina of true Adam, making it part of the Torah/Adam package.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ כַּמָּה חִדּוּשִׁין שֶׁל תּוֹרָה, שֶׁהֵם רַק כְּמוֹ פִּנְקָס... רַק כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִין אֶל הַתּוֹרָה בְּעַצְמוֹ זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת אָדָם בֶּאֱמֶת

analysis_notes.gap_analysis_notes: Torah #245 has only one bechina edge in the dataset (תורה — אדם, edge id 121), which correctly captures the Torah's central identity claim: 'הַתּוֹרָה הִיא בְּחִינַת אָדָם.' However, the Torah text is richer than a single edge. Three additional nodes are proposed as additions: (1) חַדְרֵי תּוֹרָה — the inner chambers that represent true Torah attainment, bechina of the true Torah/Adam; (2) הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת — the evil mirror, palaces that produce counterfeit Torah innovations, described via 'לְעֻמַּת זֶה'; (3) חִדּוּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה אֲמִתִּיִּים — the highest level of true Torah insight which the text equates with בְּחִינַת אָדָם בֶּאֱמֶת. The concepts of שַׁעֲרֵי הַקְּדֻשָּׁה, אוֹר הַתּוֹרָה, and הַצַּדִּיק are mentioned but serve as eitza-level elements (they describe the path TO true Torah, not a bechina identity WITH Torah/Adam), so they are not proposed as additions to the package.
